text:
maria_sec: Heads up — CI just merged two scanner runs and PR #4127 is now blocked by duplicate findings with different evidence IDs. Looks like the aggregator appended results twice. Anyone seen this merger noise before?
ajay: saw one similar last month when the pipeline retried a job and both artifacts got uploaded. the aggregator didn't dedupe by fingerprint.
kevin-oncall: the retried job is suspicious — we had an ephemeral KMS grant rollback earlier today, maybe the upload failed then retried. check keystore logs? :eyes:
tara-devx: filing a quick triage: are the failing rules actually actionable or just missing attachments? if it's missing attachments we can temporarily relax the premerge gate for that rule and triage manually.
maria_sec: I pulled the scan artifacts — one set has evidence links, the other points to S3 keys that 403. KMS decrypts for the scanner SA failed around 09:12 UTC.
scan-bot: [ScanRunner] PR 4127 — SAST results posted (2 files). Summary: 18 findings (5 high, 13 medium). Attachment upload status: fileA.json (ok), fileB.json (403).
ajay: that lines up. when the scanner couldn't upload attachments due to KMS decrypt error, the job retried and created a new result with new evidence ids but not replacing the old placeholder. aggregator doesn't treat 403-blob as replaceable.
kevin-oncall: I can see the KMS audit: serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam was denied crypto:Decrypt on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scan/cryptoKeys/attachKey at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z. A subsequent grant at 09:12:45 allowed decrypt and upload succeeded.
tara-devx: Proposed short-term: disable strict gating for rule id scan:cred-exposure on master for that PR and mark the duplicate entries as orphaned in the triage board. Long-term: change aggregator to dedupe by (finding fingerprint + PR id) and prefer evidence with successful uploads.
maria_sec: Agreed. Also need an audit trail: capture which KMS grant/role change caused the transient denial. kevin, can you link the IAM change log?
kevin-oncall: pinging infra to surface the IAM change. preliminary: an automated rotation job briefly removed roles from the scanner SA while rotating key versions. I've created infra ticket INFRA-2456 with links to audit log entries.
ajay: for a safe aggregator change we should add heuristics: if two findings same fingerprint and one has evidence that 403s, pick the evidence with HTTP 200 or valid blob hash. fallback to latest timestamp if neither has good evidence.
tara-devx: I'll open a tiny RFC for the aggregator change and include a migration step to mark existing duplicates. cc @maria_sec for security acceptance criteria: we need no silent loss of attachments and clear audit flags when KMS denies occur.
maria_sec: Security acceptance: aggregator must surface any evidence with missing attachments as "orphaned-evidence" and add the IAM audit reference (log entry id) to the finding metadata so triage can see why the evidence is missing.
scan-bot: [Action] Created ticket SEC-3964 "Aggregator dedupe + orphan evidence metadata" and linked INFRA-2456.
kevin-oncall: temporary mitigation done: relaxed gating for PR 4127 and noted manual triage required. also emailed affected product owner.
ajay: quick workaround script for triagers: `./scripts/fix-orphan-evidence.sh --pr 4127` will annotate the PR with attachment status and evidence links. Use only for manual triage.
tara-devx: thanks. I'll add the RFC link and schedule a 30-min sync with infra/agg owners tomorrow.
maria_sec: perfect — once infra confirms IAM rotation root cause and aggregator RFC lands, we'll close the loop. :thumbsup:
